The '''Thyrsian special forces''' was the [[Special forces/Legends|special forces]] division of the [[Thyrsian]] [[Thyrsian military|military]], a [[Subspecies/Legends|subspecies]] of the [[Echani/Legends|Echani]] who waged wars of independence against [[Echani Command]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Thyrsus/Legends|Thyrsus]] during the [[Begali Uprising]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[1154 BBY]]. By the time that Thyrsian independence was recognized by the [[Pact of Almera]] in [[899 BBY]], the division had evolved into the seminomadic [[Sun Guard]] warriors.
